nodes.lore: Every name on this gate has been scratched out from within.
nodes.name: Gate of Unkept Names
nodes.reply: Beneath the cuts, one command survives: Remember us without waking us.
nodes.speaker: You

nodes.lore: The paving divides around a root older than the wall. Both tracks carry fresh mud.
nodes.name: Rootbound Fork
nodes.reply: The western road serves the graves. The eastern road follows the water toward the sanctum.
nodes.speaker: You

nodes.lore: Do not pull the thorns from your cloak. They are how she counts who leaves.
nodes.name: Pilgrims' Hollow
nodes.reply: The hermit remembers a gardener who asked the roots to hold the dying until spring.
nodes.speaker: Briar Hermit

nodes.lore: The stones are worn at the knees, not the feet.
nodes.name: Broken Processional
nodes.reply: The faithful crawled this road carrying water in their hands.
nodes.speaker: You

nodes.lore: Something beneath the moss breathes against the stair. A blight hound lifts its head.
nodes.name: Moss Stair
nodes.reply: Its collar bears the same flower carved on the sanctuary door.
nodes.speaker: You

nodes.lore: A gold cup stands beneath a roof that fell generations ago. It is still full.
nodes.name: Chapel of Small Mercies
nodes.reply: Rain gathers here even beneath clear skies. Someone kept one small promise.
nodes.speaker: You

nodes.lore: A child's wooden shoe rests beside an adult's stone effigy.
nodes.name: Widow's Recess
nodes.reply: The inscription leaves space for a second name that was never added.
nodes.speaker: You

nodes.lore: I leave one grave open. If I fill it, I have to admit whom it was for.
nodes.name: The Last Grave Tender
nodes.reply: The tender says the Matriarch buried her own name before giving the roots her voice.
nodes.speaker: Grave Tender

nodes.lore: The reliquary holds seeds wrapped in burial cloth, each labeled with a season.
nodes.name: Seed Reliquary
nodes.reply: None is marked spring. The sanctum has been waiting longer than its gardeners lived.
nodes.speaker: You

nodes.lore: A narrow window faces away from the forest and toward the great tree.
nodes.name: Abandoned Watch Chapel
nodes.reply: The watchers feared what their sanctuary might become, not what might enter it.
nodes.speaker: You

nodes.lore: State whom you have come to mourn. A blade is not an answer.
nodes.name: Bridge of Bound Vows
nodes.reply: Those who cannot name their dead are made to carry the watcher's grief instead.
nodes.speaker: Oathbound Watcher

nodes.lore: A second road leaves the gate beside a channel cut into the rock.
nodes.name: Waterward Fork
nodes.reply: The channel once carried offerings downstream. Now the roots drink before the river can.
nodes.speaker: You

nodes.lore: I write the names she forgets. The bark heals faster each year.
nodes.name: Thorn Scribe
nodes.reply: The scribe shows you a fresh name: their own. They do not remember writing it.
nodes.speaker: Thorn Scribe

nodes.lore: A blight hound waits where the bridge narrows, its muzzle tangled in prayer cords.
nodes.name: Lower Stone Bridge
nodes.reply: The cords were tied to keep a beloved animal from straying. They held too well.
nodes.speaker: You

nodes.lore: Wax fills every crack in the landing, but no wick remains.
nodes.name: Candleless Landing
nodes.reply: The mourners stopped lighting candles when the roots began reaching toward the flame.
nodes.speaker: You

nodes.lore: A kneeling statue holds a bowl toward the waterfall.
nodes.name: East Chapel Steps
nodes.reply: The bowl is dry. Its underside is engraved: Give without being seen.
nodes.speaker: You

nodes.lore: She took our hunger first. We thanked her. Then she took what we hungered for.
nodes.name: Keeper of the Empty Bowl
nodes.reply: The keeper asks you to remember the taste of bread aloud. For a moment, they smile.
nodes.speaker: Chapel Keeper

nodes.lore: A leather satchel hangs above the spray, protected by a curtain of thorns.
nodes.name: Waterfall Oratory
nodes.reply: Inside lies a farewell never delivered: I will wait at the lower bridge until dawn.
nodes.speaker: You

nodes.lore: Speak softly. The leaves repeat whatever they hear to Mother.
nodes.name: The Listening Hedge
nodes.reply: The pilgrim will let a quiet traveler pass, but a drawn weapon makes every branch turn.
nodes.speaker: Rootbound Pilgrim

nodes.lore: Footprints circle a single root before joining the upper path.
nodes.name: Pilgrim's Turn
nodes.reply: Every pilgrim paused here. The root is polished like a handrail.
nodes.speaker: You

nodes.lore: A fallen bell lies stuffed with moss, its clapper deliberately removed.
nodes.name: Rear Watch Ruin
nodes.reply: The watch chose silence on the night the tree first answered a prayer.
nodes.speaker: You

nodes.lore: She is not guarding the dead from you. She is guarding them from the morning.
nodes.name: The Unnamed Gardener
nodes.reply: The gardener remembers the Matriarch's first wish: let no one under my care be lost.
nodes.speaker: Unnamed Gardener

nodes.lore: Every root points inward. The stair rises into a silence that feels held shut.
nodes.name: Sanctum Stair
nodes.reply: Beyond these steps, the Thorn Matriarch keeps the promise that ruined this place.
nodes.speaker: You

nodes.lore: I kept them. Every one. Would you have me call that a sin?
nodes.name: Heart of Briar Sanctum
nodes.reply: Defeat loosens the roots without erasing the graves. The dungeon is cleared; its memories remain.
nodes.speaker: Thorn Matriarch

nodes.lore: Your reflection reaches the gate a moment before you do.
nodes.name: Gate of Second Faces
nodes.reply: Two roads circle the tarn: the garden path to the west and the high causeway to the east.
nodes.speaker: You

nodes.lore: The snow is broken by footsteps that never seem to leave.
nodes.name: Winter Garden Fork
nodes.reply: Most turn toward the glasshouse. One set walks backward toward the palace.
nodes.speaker: You

nodes.lore: Leave your reflection with me. Guests must not bring strangers into court.
nodes.name: The Unreflected Porter
nodes.reply: The porter carries receipts for shadows, smiles, and the right to be remembered.
nodes.speaker: Palace Porter

nodes.lore: The fountain is frozen around a falling drop.
nodes.name: Fountain of Still Water
nodes.reply: The plaque promises a moment without sorrow. It never says the moment will end.
nodes.speaker: You

nodes.lore: The Regent wanted flowers that could not die. Glass was only the first attempt.
nodes.name: Gardener of Glass
nodes.reply: The gardener kept one seed beneath their tongue through every winter of the court.
nodes.speaker: Winter Gardener

nodes.lore: The collapsed glasshouse shelters a box of ordinary earth.
nodes.name: Shattered Conservatory
nodes.reply: Its label reads: For when Her Grace tires of perfection.
nodes.speaker: You

nodes.lore: Glass ribs make a cage around an empty planting bed.
nodes.name: Glasshouse Crossing
nodes.reply: There are no roots. These flowers were installed, not grown.
nodes.speaker: You

nodes.lore: A porcelain sentry turns its face to match yours.
nodes.name: Statue Walk
nodes.reply: Its weapon is real, though its hands are only reflected in the snow.
nodes.speaker: You

nodes.lore: The same farewell is carved into every step in a different hand.
nodes.name: The White Landing
nodes.reply: Each courtier thought they were the first to ask permission to leave.
nodes.speaker: You

nodes.lore: Bow to the image, never the guest. Images do not change their loyalties.
nodes.name: Bridge of Courtesy
nodes.reply: The usher admits the Regent has not crossed this bridge since the first mirror cracked.
nodes.speaker: Mirror Usher

nodes.lore: I saw the original die. Every morning since, another reflection has denied it.
nodes.name: The Thawing Witness
nodes.reply: The witness cannot tell you which death they mean. Their testimony changes with the light.
nodes.speaker: Court Witness

nodes.lore: The other road crosses dark water on broad stone arches.
nodes.name: Causeway Fork
nodes.reply: The balustrade is warmer than the air, as if another season waits inside the stone.
nodes.speaker: You

nodes.lore: A glass-armored sentinel drags its spear along the bridge rail.
nodes.name: The Tarn Span
nodes.reply: Each scratch in the rail matches a scar visible beneath its transparent armor.
nodes.speaker: You

nodes.lore: Voices rise through the arches, repeating a conversation you have not had.
nodes.name: Listening Balustrade
nodes.reply: One voice sounds like yours. It says that you should have taken the garden road.
nodes.speaker: You

nodes.lore: Before the ice, I carried people across. Now I ferry apologies. Neither ever returns.
nodes.name: The Ferry Without Oars
nodes.reply: The ferryman points to a palace window where a lantern answers only at noon.
nodes.speaker: Stranded Ferryman

nodes.lore: A brass box contains toll coins polished perfectly blank.
nodes.name: Icebound Tollhouse
nodes.reply: The Regent would permit no other sovereign's face within sight of the palace.
nodes.speaker: You

nodes.lore: Show me the face you wore when you entered. No substitutions.
nodes.name: Rime Watch
nodes.reply: The warden remembers every visitor and no departure. A respectful answer can delay its suspicion.
nodes.speaker: Rime Warden

nodes.lore: Frost has formed on the underside of the steps, against the wind.
nodes.name: Eastern Stair
nodes.reply: The cold comes from the hall, not from the mountains.
nodes.speaker: You

nodes.lore: One mirror has had its silver scraped away, leaving a view of bare stone.
nodes.name: The Unsilvered Niche
nodes.reply: Someone chose the wall over the face the court demanded.
nodes.speaker: You

nodes.lore: A face is easier to mend when its owner stops moving.
nodes.name: The Seamstress of Faces
nodes.reply: She remembers sewing mourning veils until the Regent outlawed the suggestion of loss.
nodes.speaker: Court Seamstress

nodes.lore: Two sentries move as one. Only one leaves tracks.
nodes.name: Court of Repeated Steps
nodes.reply: The tracks stop before each mirror and begin again on the other side.
nodes.speaker: You

nodes.lore: The basin reflects an intact palace under a summer sky.
nodes.name: Blackwater Basin
nodes.reply: A figure at its window closes the curtain when you lean closer.
nodes.speaker: You

nodes.lore: Your reflection remains at the threshold after you step away.
nodes.name: Threshold of True Silver
nodes.reply: It mouths a warning: do not let her choose which of you leaves.
nodes.speaker: You

nodes.lore: I have perfected this court. It is the world outside that refuses correction.
nodes.name: Hall of Mirrors
nodes.reply: Victory cracks the false summer in every mirror. The dungeon clears as the tarn begins to thaw.
nodes.speaker: Glass Regent

nodes.lore: The gate is warm enough to hurt through a glove. No fire burns nearby.
nodes.name: Gate of Banked Coals
nodes.reply: A pilgrim stair climbs directly toward the chapel; a works road loops through the lower kilns.
nodes.speaker: You

nodes.lore: Two sets of footprints separate: bare feet uphill, iron boots toward the works.
nodes.name: The Ashen Divide
nodes.reply: Pilgrims and furnace workers shared a gate, but not a destination.
nodes.speaker: You

nodes.lore: Nothing enters empty-handed. What will you give the flame?
nodes.name: The Coal Tally
nodes.reply: The tally board counts workers by weight, beside the coal and the ore.
nodes.speaker: Chain Scavenger

nodes.lore: Ash has settled into the shape of tools that were taken away long ago.
nodes.name: Kiln Approach
nodes.reply: Every tool faced the chapel when the workers laid it down.
nodes.speaker: You

nodes.lore: We thought the heat was a blessing. Then the saint stopped asking for fuel.
nodes.name: The Last Stoker
nodes.reply: The old stoker remembers the first night the furnace burned on a prayer alone.
nodes.speaker: Old Stoker

nodes.lore: A sealed lunch tin sits between heaps of coal that never caught.
nodes.name: Cold Coal Shed
nodes.reply: Inside, a note asks its reader to be home before the evening bell.
nodes.speaker: You

nodes.lore: A cinder mantis unfolds from a slag heap, its legs ringing against the stone.
nodes.name: Quenching Yard
nodes.reply: It has nested in a quenching trough dry since the water was diverted to the chapel.
nodes.speaker: You

nodes.lore: A small iron hand protects a candle from the furnace wind.
nodes.name: Worker's Niche
nodes.reply: Its inscription offers no miracle, only a safe return after work.
nodes.speaker: You

nodes.lore: They confessed exhaustion. I called it doubt. I would like that written down.
nodes.name: The Soot Confessor
nodes.reply: The confessor has kept every worker's name on strips of unburned cloth.
nodes.speaker: Soot Confessor

nodes.lore: The stair is swept clean while the surrounding terraces lie deep in ash.
nodes.name: The Red Stair
nodes.reply: Someone still prepares this approach for a congregation that cannot come.
nodes.speaker: You

nodes.lore: The great brazier is cold. Its rim has melted inward.
nodes.name: Brazier of Petition
nodes.reply: The offerings stopped here when the furnace learned to call the petitioners by name.
nodes.speaker: You

nodes.lore: The direct stair climbs above a fissure glowing beneath the paving.
nodes.name: Pilgrims' Stair
nodes.reply: The handrail bears thousands of fingerprints baked into old soot.
nodes.speaker: You

nodes.lore: An ember-starved pilgrim blocks the stair, guarding a coal in cupped hands.
nodes.name: Procession Landing
nodes.reply: The coal is cold. The pilgrim has not noticed.
nodes.speaker: You

nodes.lore: If it goes out, she said we all go out. Help me remember who she meant.
nodes.name: Bearer of the Last Coal
nodes.reply: The bearer remembers children warming their hands at the chapel before the doors were chained.
nodes.speaker: Coal Bearer

nodes.lore: Empty reliquary sockets line the stair like missing teeth.
nodes.name: Reliquary Steps
nodes.reply: Each held a saint's bone until the furnace demanded a warmer offering.
nodes.speaker: You

nodes.lore: The upper works are closed. The order is old; my oath is older.
nodes.name: Iron Viaduct
nodes.reply: The warden will hear a worker's grievance. A threat turns its chain across the bridge.
nodes.speaker: Bridge Warden

nodes.lore: The iron supports sing at a pitch too low to hear clearly.
nodes.name: Eastern Abutment
nodes.reply: The bridge was tuned to the chapel's hymn so the workers could pray without stopping.
nodes.speaker: You

nodes.lore: A balance hangs level with a prayer tablet on one pan and a tooth on the other.
nodes.name: The Weigh House
nodes.reply: Its ledger assigns the same value to both: one more hour of heat.
nodes.speaker: You

nodes.lore: No one dismissed us. Until someone does, the shift is not over.
nodes.name: Foreman Without a Shift
nodes.reply: The foreman asks for the workers' names to be spoken outside the reach of the furnace.
nodes.speaker: Ash Foreman

nodes.lore: A cinder mantis has woven hot wire across the old service path.
nodes.name: High Works Crossing
nodes.reply: The wire was once part of the alarm system. No one answered its last ringing.
nodes.speaker: You

nodes.lore: The works road and pilgrim stair meet before the chapel terrace.
nodes.name: The Joining Road
nodes.reply: Here the ash erases the difference between bare feet and iron boots.
nodes.speaker: You

nodes.lore: Gold trim blackens above a row of names struck from the list of saints.
nodes.name: Chapel Forecourt
nodes.reply: The scratched names belong to those who told the congregation to leave.
nodes.speaker: You

nodes.lore: Heat presses against you like a held breath. The chains are fastened from within.
nodes.name: Furnace Threshold
nodes.reply: The Furnace Saint has mistaken endurance for devotion. The door opens when you stop kneeling.
nodes.speaker: You

nodes.lore: You call it suffering because you have not yet learned to burn clean.
nodes.name: Furnace Chapel
nodes.reply: Victory banks the sacred furnace. Volcanic haze settles, the workers' shift ends, and the dungeon clears.
nodes.speaker: Furnace Saint

flee.success: Retreat to previous node; encounter stays unresolved

scenes.name: Heart of Briar Sanctum — Boss Arena
